sample.question:
The image shows a six-face cube net. The cube starts with U on top, F in front, and R on the right. A roll north/east/south/west moves the cube in that direction without twisting.
After the roll sequence west, north, north, south, west, south, which emblem faces front?
A. Cross
B. Sun
C. Circle
D. Bars
E. Diamond
F. Triangle
sample.analysis: Applying every roll to the six-role orientation yields {"top": "R", "bottom": "L", "front": "D", "back": "U", "left": "F", "right": "B"}. The front face is D, so its emblem is Cross. The answer is A.
